context.item: Workflow snapshot (`n8n/room-parent-updater.json`) now includes validated HMAC webhooks + Admin queue signing; writebacks/digests remain stubbed.
Security scrub complete; secrets replaced with placeholders across repo; HMAC helper script + validation flow confirmed via Node harness.
Prompt library, Apps Script scaffold, and sanitized MCP configs ready; Main tasks center on wiring production-grade n8n flow + HITL surfaces.

objectives.item: Ship v1 Room Parent Agent end-to-end: ingestion → diff → HITL approvals → writebacks → WhatsApp + digests following build spec.
Replace token approvals with HMAC contract across Sheets sidebar + email links.
Document runbook + release notes for public GitHub readiness.

phase.name: AM Setup (07:00–09:30 PT)
phase.step: Verify cleaned repo, refresh workflow snapshot via MCP list/get (capture ID, confirm node inventory, backup before edits).
Design revised node map: dedicated schedule triggers (2h windowed, daily, weekly), ingestion lanes (Gmail, Drive→PDF→text), diff/queue modules, approval webhooks.
Draft node-by-node patch plan (documented in `ROOM PARENT AGENT` spec annotations) before applying MCP diffs.

phase.name: Build Core Flow (09:30–13:00 PT)
phase.step: Implement schedule triggers: time-filtered 2h poll (08–20 PT) + daily 18:00 + weekly Sunday 18:00.
Wire ingestion: Gmail search with lookback + dedupe, Drive PDF watcher with OCR fallback, fan-out to Gemini extractor using `prompts/extractor.txt`.
Construct diff layer: read Sheets (`Snack`, `Allergies` read-only), Calendar (next 60d); build deterministic diff JSON (events, snack changes, allergy notes, notices) with source links + metadata.
Generate Admin queue dataset matching schema (`WhenFound | Type | Summary | SourceLink | ApproveLink | RejectLink | Status`).

phase.name: Approvals & Writebacks (13:00–16:00 PT)
phase.step: Swap token system for HMAC: update webhook nodes to require signature, update `Make Approval Links` (or new signer node) to precompute `sha256` header for Sheets/email links leveraging `store.approvalsHmacSecret`.
Update Apps Script (`gas/Code.gs`) + email templates to send signed payloads; confirm 24h expiry logic resides in n8n validation.
Implement approval processing: safe upsert to Snack sheet (idempotent by Week+Child), Calendar create/update/cancel with dedupe guard, append OpsLog entry.
Generate WhatsApp draft from approved changes via `prompts/formatter_whatsapp.txt` and stage daily/weekly digest emails (pending + metrics) using prompt templates.

phase.name: QA & Handoff (16:00–18:30 PT)
phase.step: Dry-run end-to-end with fixtures (1 Gmail, 1 PDF) → inspect queue, approve/reject sample items, verify sheet/calendar mutations + OpsLog.
Re-export workflow snapshot post-changes, update documentation (README, project plan notes, handoff daily update).
Secret sweep + checklist (`rg` scan, `.gitignore` double-check), prep GitHub release notes + instructions for resetting approvals secret after clone.
If time: smoke-test MCP tools for diff/apply to ensure automation commands remain accurate after refactor.

risks.item: Diff logic complexity: must avoid duplicate calendar/snack writes; mitigate with deterministic IDs and dry-run preview nodes before apply.
HMAC signature handling: ensure Apps Script + email links remain usable post-change; test across multiple approval pathways.
n8n schedule limitations (v1.110.1) may require conditional gating instead of cron expressions; build guard nodes to skip runs outside window.

approvalsNeeded.item: Run MCP diff/apply tools against live workflow once patches ready (will request via CLI approvals workflow).
Potential Drive/Gmail sample pulls if new fixtures needed (requires confirming with owner before contacting live services).

notes.item: Maintain sanitized placeholders in all committed artifacts; remind operator to rerun `scripts/set_approvals_secret.sh` post-clone.
Document Admin tab layout + OpsLog schema changes in README once finalized.
